name: D.P.S. SG set2
source:
D.P.S. SG set2 is the third entry in the D.P.S./Dream Program System series. Like the other D.P.S. games, it is a collection of three short scenarios, which are unrelated to each other story-wise and can be played separately. Those scenarios are presented as cartridges played on a fictional console named Dream Program System. Each scenario allows the player to choose between two different protagonists, or two different personalities for the protagonist. All of the scenarios feature nudity and/or sexual situations.

The scenarios in this game include:

A horror story entitled Antique House, in which a young couple is trapped at night in a secluded haunted mansion, possessed by monsters. The player can choose the personality of the female character before beginning, influencing the story with this choice.

A modern-day story without any supernatural elements, entitled Red Night. The protagonist is a man who finds himself in a hotel when a fire starts. Trying to escape, he enters a room occupied by a prostitute. The following events evolve slightly differently, depending on the personality choice made by the player before the start of the game.

A sequel to the second episode of the first D.P.S. game. Once again, the player chooses either the male doctor Katsuki or the female doctor Katsumi whose goal is to seduce the patient, the cute school girl Yumiko.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/dps-sg-set-2]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《D.P.S. SG set2》是《D.P.S.／梦幻程序系统》系列第三作。与其他《D.P.S.》作品一样，本作由三段彼此毫无关联、可以单独游玩的短篇剧情组成，并将它们包装成虚构主机“梦幻程序系统”上的游戏卡带。每段剧情都允许玩家在两名不同主角之间作出选择，或为同一主角选择两种不同性格。所有剧情均含有裸体和／或性情境。

本作收录以下剧情：

恐怖故事《古董宅邸》讲述一对年轻情侣夜间受困于远离人烟的鬼宅，那里已被怪物占据。玩家可在开始前选择女主角的性格，以此影响剧情。

《赤夜》是一段不含任何超自然元素的现代故事。男主角身处酒店时突然发生火灾；他在逃生途中闯进一个妓女所在的房间。之后的事件会根据玩家开局前选择的性格产生细微变化。

第三段是初代《D.P.S.》第二篇剧情的续作。玩家再次选择男医生胜树或女医生胜美，目标是诱惑患者——可爱的女学生由美子。
